preregistered.primary_metric: Instagram reach at the snapshot closest to 72h after posting (48h to 96h), divided by the median 72h reach of same-format posts published in the 28 days before start_date
preregistered.secondary_metric: Instagram views at the same snapshot, reported only and not used for the decision; Facebook is not used because the page reaches 1 to 2 accounts per post
preregistered.analysis_unit: Each slot is analysed separately: the slot 1 afternoon arm against the slot 1 usual arm, and the slot 2 early-evening arm against the slot 2 usual arm. Slots are never pooled because they test different windows and carry different content types.
preregistered.decision_rule: Per slot: move that slot to its test window if the test arm's median ratio is at least 0.30 higher than that slot's usual arm and a two-sided permutation test gives p < 0.10; keep the usual time if it is at least 0.30 lower; otherwise extend by 14 days.
preregistered.notes: probability_afternoon is the probability of the test arm for every slot and keeps its original name for compatibility.
